charts.disclaimer: Reconstruction of Chang 2024 Figure 1. The branching order is the guideline's own: syndrome / involvement first, then host (HIV, SOT, non-HIV/non-SOT), then severity; species appears only as a modifier (Panel 13, Panel 15). Regimens, durations and grades are transcribed from Figure 1 and the cited panels — use the original Figure/Panel text for definitive wording.
